name: Defines Secret
description: A repository, an organisation account, or a deployment environment defines an Actions secret. The edge carries the secret's existence and which of the three scopes holds it; the node carries its NAME and timestamps. No value is read or stored — GitHub's API cannot return one. All three sources matter for reference resolution: a name absent from one scope is routinely present in another, and reading only repository scope makes shared organisation credentials look nonexistent.
